name: Ferran Adrià
bio: Catalan chef of elBulli on the Costa Brava, who made the foam, the sphere and the deconstructed dish into the language of a new kitchen.

milestones.event: Became head chef of elBulli in Roses.
Served the first siphon foams at elBulli.
Made spherification a dish at elBulli, with sodium alginate and a calcium bath.
Closed the restaurant elBulli and turned it into a foundation.
